Date: 2026-08-12T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Launch Assist request: Kickstart package and milestones

Hi Mina,

Thanks for the demo last week — SeedFoundry is excited about the speed and cost profile of Redwood. We run a 12-week accelerator and would like to include a small pilot for three of our portfolio companies.

Can you approve a one-time "Kickstart" allocation: 250k tokens each (3 startups) + a single dedicated demo VM for day-of-workshop support? Our standard procurement needs a confirmation email and a one-page usage milestone table to process the grant.

Attached is a draft of our commercial intake (ops contact: ops@seedfoundry.co) and an outline of the program timeline. If this fits your partner credits program, we'd ask for an activation window through Nov 30, 2026.

Best,
Amelia Park
Director, Portfolio Partnerships
SeedFoundry Labs

Hi Amelia,

Appreciate the clear ask — sounds like a good fit for our accelerator partner credits program. Quick answers up-front: 1) We can provision 250k tokens per team for three teams; 2) We can reserve a small dedicated VM for the workshop (subject to capacity windows); 3) We normally set a 90-day activation, but we can extend to Nov 30 if we align on milestones.

Two asks from my side to formalize:
- Please confirm the companies' names and expected monthly token usage (even rough numbers).
- Fill out the simple milestones sheet attached so we can route for approval (ops/procurement needs an M0-M2 deliverable map).

Looping in Karthik from Partnerships to speed approval. I'll start a short internal note for credits approval.

Cheers,
Mina
Partnerships (Startup Programs)

Thanks Mina — quick internal note for approval flow:

1) Credits: 750k total tokens (250k x 3). This falls into our standard partner promo bucket; no legal SOW required but procurement wants the milestones sheet attached and a single signature.
2) Dedicated VM: We can earmark a demo VM for the workshop date, but we need a 48-hour confirmed time window and an ops lead. This can be delivered as an "ops on-call" line item (2 hours of support).
3) Activation window: We can extend to Nov 30 for usage activation; we'll set an expiration on unused tokens.

Approval decision: I approve the credits and on-call ops for this engagement subject to the milestones sheet and a signed acceptance from SeedFoundry Ops. Please attach the milestone spreadsheet and the short acceptance text for signature.

Karthik
Head of Partnerships
Redwood Inference
